# `db_explain_query`

Get the EXPLAIN (query execution plan) output for a SQL query.

**Admin-only: requires `x-access-scope` bit `0x04`**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sql` | string | SQL query to explain |

**Returns**: Plain text EXPLAIN output.
